enable_cash_register.label: Enable the cash drawer
enable_cash_register.description: Turns on cash drawer management (opening and closing a session).

require_blind_count.label: Blind count
require_blind_count.description: Whoever counts the drawer does not see the expected cash until they declare the count. Supervisors (with the «see expected totals» permission) still see it.

auto_close_enabled.label: Daily automatic close
auto_close_enabled.description: If nobody has closed the drawer, the hub closes it on its own at the time below (the business's local time) with the calculated expected cash and no count; the close is attributed to the system and flagged in the notes.

auto_close_time.label: Automatic close time
auto_close_time.description: Local time at which any session still open is closed (Toast closes at 04:00 by default).

protected_pos_url.label: Protected POS route
protected_pos_url.description: Route of the POS that requires the drawer to be open.

setup.title: Your cash drawer
setup.description: Decide how the till opens and closes: the opening float, the closing count and the POS screen that stays locked until the drawer is open.

ui.title: Cash Register
ui.errSessionAlreadyOpen: A cash session is already open. Close it before opening a new one.
ui.errOpeningBalanceRequired: This business requires an opening float: enter the cash the drawer starts with.
ui.errClosingBalanceRequired: This business requires the drawer to be counted at closing: enter the counted cash.
ui.errCountedCashRequired: Enter the counted cash to close the session.
ui.errNegativeBalanceNotAllowed: This cash-out would leave the drawer below zero, and negative balances are not allowed.
ui.errSessionUnavailable: That cash session is not available: it does not exist in this business or it has been deleted.
ui.errMovementTypeUnknown: That is not a kind of cash movement: use in, out, sale or refund.
ui.errAmountRequired: A cash movement needs an amount: enter how much money goes in or out of the drawer.
ui.errPaymentMethodUnknown: That is not a way of paying the drawer knows: use cash, card, transfer or other.
ui.errNotEnoughIds: The sale could not be booked into the drawer: one of its payments was left without an entry. Nothing was recorded — take the sale again.
ui.errRefundNotEnoughIds: The refund could not be recorded in the till: one of its legs had no entry left to write. Nothing was recorded — issue the refund again.
ui.errRefundRefRequired: The refund could not be recorded in the till: it arrived without a document reference, and without one the till cannot tell a retry from a second refund. Nothing was recorded.
ui.errRefundNoOpenSession: The refund could not be recorded in the till: no cash session is open, so there is nowhere to book the money that left the drawer. Open the till and record it as a cash withdrawal.
ui.toggleRequireBlindCount: Blind count (hide expected cash until counted)
ui.errLoadDetail: Could not load the session detail
ui.shiftReviewUnavailable: Pending work could not be checked, so this review may be incomplete.
ui.shiftReviewConfirm: The shift will be closed anyway. Press again to confirm.
